messages:
Maria: Thanks for coming to the runtime roadmap segment. Starting a live thread for quick follow-ups and outstanding Qs. Drop short notes here.

Jules: Quick recap: short-term = patch slow attention kernels; medium = dynamic batching + predictive flush; longer = fused ops prototype + stable quant path.

Sam: For dynamic batching, will p95 be preserved for 1-3 token requests?

Jules: We aim to preserve p95. Strategy: aggressive predictive flush for tiny requests, batch smoothing for medium sizes. Tests will include p95 regression suite.

Omar: Any changes expected to SDK semantics or response ordering?

Ravi: No ordering changes. New SDK flags planned for opt-in behaviors (batch_hint, latency_budget_ms). Defaults remain backward compatible.

Kara: KV cache question: long conversations see a lot of thrash. Is there an eviction plan?

Jules: Prototype: segmented LRU + prefix pin whitelist so system and recent prefixes stay hot. We'll run canary on subset of traffic.

Priya: How will Dedicated customers be notified about kernel rollouts?

Maria: We'll ship release notes + optional canary windows, and offer rollback artifacts for Private clusters.

Sam: On quantization timeline: are we doing sim first or straight to INT8 runtime?

Jules: Simulation and metrics in Q3, production INT8 gated on eval stability in Q4.

Omar: Autoscaler interactions: could batching cause scale-up thrash?

Ravi: We'll make autoscaler queue-aware; soft-scale earlier based on predicted batch demand to avoid flush storms. Draft PR coming.

Priya: Request: can leadership publish a rollback checklist (signals + thresholds)?

Maria: Yes. Leadership asked for explicit rollback criteria per rollout. We'll post templates.

Sam: Action: I'll add 15 p95 short-context evals to the shared eval repo.

Jules: Action: I'll share kernel landing checklist and perf baselines by Thu.

Ravi: Action: autoscaler proto PR by next Wed.

Kara: Offer to pair on SDK flag design if helpful.

meeting-bot: Slides and recording uploaded: https://meetings.redwood.ai/rec/1801234567

Maria: Thanks all v. I'll circulate minutes and link the docs. If anything else, reply here or DM.
